# WebUtil — Free Online Developer Tools

Free online developer tools that run 100% client-side in your browser. No data is uploaded to any server. No sign-ups, no tracking, no limits. Built with Astro, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://webutil.tech): Browse all 50+ free developer tools
- [Blog](https://webutil.tech/blog): Developer guides and tutorials
- [About](https://webutil.tech/about): About the project and tech stack
- [FAQ](https://webutil.tech/faq): Frequently asked questions
- [Tools](https://webutil.tech/tools): Complete tool index

## JSON & Data Tools

- [JSON Formatter](https://webutil.tech/dev/json-formatter): Format, validate, and beautify JSON with syntax highlighting
- [JSON to CSV](https://webutil.tech/dev/json-to-csv): Convert JSON arrays to CSV with BOM and nested object flattening
- [YAML Converter](https://webutil.tech/dev/yaml-converter): Convert between YAML and JSON with live preview
- [XML Formatter](https://webutil.tech/dev/xml-formatter): Format, validate, and beautify XML documents
- [SQL Formatter](https://webutil.tech/dev/sql-formatter): Beautify SQL queries with customizable indentation

## Encoding & Security

- [Base64 Encoder](https://webutil.tech/dev/base64-encoder): Encode and decode text/files to/from Base64
- [URL Encoder](https://webutil.tech/dev/url-encoder): Encode and decode URLs and query parameters
- [HTML Entities](https://webutil.tech/dev/html-entities): Convert special characters to HTML entities
- [Hash Generator](https://webutil.tech/dev/hash-generator): Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 hashes
- [JWT Decoder](https://webutil.tech/dev/jwt-decoder): Decode and inspect JWT token header, payload, and signature
- [JWT Expiration Checker](https://webutil.tech/dev/jwt-expiration-checker): Check JWT token expiration and claims

## Generators

- [Password Generator](https://webutil.tech/generate/password-generator): Cryptographically secure random passwords
- [UUID Generator](https://webutil.tech/generate/uuid-generator): Generate UUID v4 identifiers, bulk up to 100
- [UUID v7 Generator](https://webutil.tech/generate/uuid-v7-generator): Time-ordered UUID v7 identifiers
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://webutil.tech/generate/lorem-ipsum): Generate placeholder text
- [QR Code Generator](https://webutil.tech/generate/qr-code-generator): Create QR codes from text or URLs, download as SVG
- [Wi-Fi QR Code Generator](https://webutil.tech/generate/wi-fi-qr-code-generator): QR code for instant Wi-Fi network access
- [Secure WPA2 Password Generator](https://webutil.tech/generate/secure-wpa2-password-generator): Router-friendly passwords without ambiguous characters

## Conversion Tools

- [Color Converter](https://webutil.tech/dev/color-converter): Convert between HEX, RGB, HSL, and named CSS colors
- [Case Converter](https://webutil.tech/text/case-converter): Convert between camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, etc.
- [px to rem Converter](https://webutil.tech/dev/px-to-rem): Convert pixel values to rem units
- [Image Converter](https://webutil.tech/dev/image-converter): Convert images between PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF

## Text Tools

- [Markdown Preview](https://webutil.tech/text/markdown-preview): Write and preview Markdown with live HTML rendering
- [Text Diff Checker](https://webutil.tech/text/text-diff): Compare two texts side-by-side
- [Regex Tester](https://webutil.tech/text/regex-tester): Test regular expressions with match highlighting
- [Word & Character Counter](https://webutil.tech/text/word-counter): Count words, characters, sentences, reading time
- [Remove Duplicate Lines](https://webutil.tech/text/remove-duplicate-lines): Deduplicate and sort text lines

## Validators

- [Kubernetes YAML Validator](https://webutil.tech/dev/kubernetes-yaml-validator): Validate K8s manifests
- [Docker Compose Validator](https://webutil.tech/dev/docker-compose-validator): Validate docker-compose.yml files
- [GitHub Actions Validator](https://webutil.tech/dev/github-actions-validator): Validate workflow YAML syntax
